title: Schutzklick Makler
meta_description: Manage your insurance on your smartphone - easy & free.
full_description: A trusted insurance manager in your pocket.Experienced insurance specialists advise you at any time to find the right insurance for you and to optimize your current contracts. We compare offers from over 200 insurances and find the offer that best suits your needs.Your advantages at a glance:* Many years of expertise. Experienced insurance experts advise you to find the best insurance for you.* With protection click brokers your insurances become digital - all insurances always and everywhere at a glance.* With Schutzklick brokers you are not alone in the claim: We take over the communication and support you with all questions.* Relationships are everything - including brokers to your personal protection. You can reach your advisor anytime, anywhere - via in-app messaging, email and phone. Your broker keeps an eye on your entire insurance portfolio.* The best: The service including advice and administration is completely free for you!*The service can be canceled anytime.How does protection click brokers1. Download the Protection Click Broker app.2. Sign up with your e-mail address and mobile number.3. We will then send you a security code via SMS, with which you verify yourself.4. From our list, select the insurance companies you are insured with and enter your contact details.5. Read the broker mandate and sign it directly on the screen with your finger. Already you can use your Schutzklick broker insurance manager and digitize all your insurance documents!You decide!Only after you have signed the broker mandate in the app do you give protection power brokers (simplesurance broker GmbH) the power of attorney that allows us to process your insurance concerns and query your insurance policies. Subsequently, all existing contract details are available in the Protection Click Broker app. Always and everywhere digitally retrievable. Without your consent, we can not make any changes even after the authorization has been granted.Safety at a high levelWe pay attention to the applicable data protection and do not sell your data to third parties. We encrypt all data (SSL) and use an SMS-TAN procedure for your registration. So your data is safe in the ProtectionClick broker app.For more information on all questions about simplesurance broker and the protection click broker app, visit our websites www.schutzklick-makler.de and www.simplesurance.com
